Q2 2026 — OUTRACE Ph1 first data expected

OUTRACE trial: most advanced off-the-shelf TCE in autoimmune. 65 kDa construct, SC favorable. Attenuated CD3 (0.5 nM affinity — intentionally sub-nM). No DLTs at 10 or 20 µg/kg; 30 µg/kg enrolling. Sites: US, EU, Australia. SLE, RA, Sjögren's cohorts. KEY GAP vs. ACE: no BCMA arm — long-lived plasma cells in bone marrow (CD19−/BCMA+) will survive CLN-978 treatment. First data Q2 2026 will set the safety/tolerability expectation for the format.

First patient dosed March 18, 2026. IgG-like SC trispecific. CD3 masking platform. NHP: deep depletion in peripheral blood + bone marrow, low cytokine release. Lead indication: Rheumatoid Arthritis. Most direct format competitor to ACE — same CD19+BCMA+CD3 architecture. Watch: RA is the wrong indication for immune reset (non-autoantibody pathology); SLE/myositis/SSc would be stronger. First human safety data H2 2026 is the milestone event.

Sanofi-backed ($2.56B deal). Sub-micromolar CD3 affinity (attenuated — CRS risk minimization). NHP data: depletion in peripheral blood AND bone marrow, sustained Ig reduction. IND filing expected 2026. Phase 1 FIH announcement is the next major catalyst. Directly competes with ACE on format; Ailux differentiates on design optimization and preclinical data quality.
Published 2024 — Bucci et al. Nature Medicine

Bucci et al. Nat Med 2024: blinatumomab (CD19×CD3 bispecific) in refractory RA. Drug-free remission achieved. Proof of concept that off-the-shelf CD19×CD3 TCE can achieve remission in autoimmune disease without CAR-T infrastructure. Blinatumomab requires continuous IV infusion — practical barrier. ACE/trispecific format provides the convenience that makes this mechanism accessible at scale.

Alexander et al. NEJM 2024: teclistamab (BCMA×CD3) in refractory SLE → clinical remission + marked autoantibody reduction. Proof that BCMA arm alone is active in autoimmune disease by clearing bone marrow plasma cells. ACE adds CD19 arm to address circulating B cells simultaneously — achieving the full B-lineage clearance that neither BCMA alone nor CD19 alone can deliver.

Müller et al. NEJM 2024: 15 SLE/SSc/myositis patients, CD19 CAR-T → complete remission, all immunosuppression stopped, drug-free 12–29 months. 5/6 SLE drug-free. The most compelling proof of concept in all of autoimmunology. ACE does not require lymphodepletion, hospital admission, or 2–8 week manufacturing time. Same depth of B-cell depletion goal, off-the-shelf.
